svg.title: Prior, normalized likelihood and posterior for a rework rate
svg.desc: Three curves over the rework rate p: a broad prior peaking near 0.125, a narrower likelihood peaking at 0.30, and the tallest curve of the three, the posterior, peaking at 0.263 between them.
svg.text: One prior, one sample, one posterior
Beta(2, 8) prior; nine reworks in thirty batches; Beta(11, 29) posterior
p, the probability that one batch needs rework
The posterior mean lands one quarter of the way from the sample proportion back toward the prior mean.
